the pre-training of the agent is crucial for its ability to learn new tasks.
our results suggest that the pre-training phase can help the agent discover better policies, but that the transfer phase is still crucial to solve the task efficiently.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we show that pre-training can be used to learn useful policies that can be transferred to new domains, and we show that the combination of fine-tuning and behavior transfer is particularly beneficial in domains that require structured exploration.
we show how pre-training and transfer can work together to solve challenging problems.
we introduce a novel technique, called Behavior Transfer (BT) that is complementary to fine-tuning neural networks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
pre-training can lead to the development of complex behavior, which can be leveraged to accelerate learning in downstream tasks.
, in reinforcement learning, the pre-trained policy can be a useful resource for transfer even if it does not directly solve the downstream task.
, in order to achieve efficient transfer in reinforcement learning, one must consider not only the transfer of neural network weights but also of behaviors.
